title: MDM Calculator UP 2026 - Mid Day Meal Hisab Kaise Lagayen
content:
Last Updated: 18 September 2026 | By MyBasicEducator Team

UP ke primary schools me MDM ka hisab lagana har teacher ki zimmedari hai. Is article me hum MDM Calculator UP ki puri jankari denge.

MDM Kya Hai?

Mid Day Meal me bachchon ko dopahar ka bhojan diya jata hai. Sarkar chawal, gehun aur conversion cost deti hai. UP Basic Education Department ne is process ko digital kar diya hai.

MDM Calculator Kaise Use Karein

1. Month select karein. 2. Attendance dalein. 3. Primary 100g aur Upper Primary 150g ka ration auto calculate hoga. 4. Print karke register me chipka dein. Teachers ko salah hai ki ve daily data update karein.

MDM Ke Naye Niyam 2026

2026 me nutrition badhane ke liye millet bhi dena hai. Iska record portal par upload karna hoga.
